metadata.case_name: CHAN KWOK KUEN v. ACTIONSPORTS INTERNATIONAL LIMITED

plaintiff.education_level: Higher Diploma from the Institute of Vocational Education (2009); Bachelor of Arts Degree (2011)

injuries.description: a complex tear involving the anterior horn, body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus
source: The MRI revealed a complex tear involving the anterior horn, body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus and a complete tear of the ACL close to the femoral insertion.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the knee or lower leg

injuries.description: a complete tear of the ACL close to the femoral insertion
source: The MRI revealed a complex tear involving the anterior horn, body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus and a complete tear of the ACL close to the femoral insertion.
the plaintiff suffered from a complex tear involving the anterior horn, body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus and a complete tear of the ACL of the left knee;
injuries.icd_description: Injury to multiple structures of knee

manifestations.description: tenderness over medial side of left knee
effusion on his left knee with clicking sensation, Lochman’s test and pivot shift test were positive
swelling of left knee and intense pain
residual wasting of his left lower limb
a sense of uneasiness with jogging, difficulty in full squat, walking downstairs and playing football
limping on two occasions when going down the stairs (as observed on surveillance video)

treatments_received: ambulance to Accident and Emergency Department of Tuen Mun Hospital
examination and sick leave at A&E
partial medial meniscectomy with left knee arthroscopy (4-hour surgery)
physiotherapy (31 sessions at North District Hospital from 14 June 2012 to 23 January 2013)
follow-up visits with Dr Raymond Lai (25 visits, last seen 14 January 2013)

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: the plaintiff has a sense of uneasiness with jogging, difficulty in full squat, walking downstairs and playing football; enjoyment of sports should be reduced
